design_philosophy: Monochrome, 1px hard-rule architecture, Unbounded display headers, JetBrains Mono body & terminal code. Procedural ASCII motion with zero fluff and strict deduplication.

consolidation_blueprint.goal: Consolidate duplicated homepage sections into a unified, high-density 5-part homepage while keeping dedicated routes (/pricing, /partners, /roi, /use-cases/healthcare, /use-cases/cfo) accessible without repeating their full summaries.
removed_or_merged_sections: Removed floating route summary cards that repeated /pricing tier breakdowns from main scroll.
Removed redundant healthcare & CFO case study landing blocks from homepage flow; replaced with direct nav route links.
Merged separate ROI estimators and Connector showcases into a single unified Tabbed Proof container.

Body text, code blocks, tab navigation, labels, data tables, metrics, AEO machine summaries

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Unbounded for headlines and key display text. Use JetBrains Mono for body, specs, code, and UI elements. Always maintain left alignment for content readability. Set tight letter spacing (`tracking-tight`) on headlines.

colors.instructions: Strict monochrome palette (pure white, deep voids, slate dark grays). Colorful accent dots are allowed exclusively inside the simulated MacBook code runner tabs.

visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Soft blur shadows are strictly prohibited.
visual_enhancers.radius: 0px sharp corners. Pill buttons (rounded-full) allowed only for primary action CTAs.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Allowed for sticky header only: bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#333333]. Never use full transparent headers.

procedural_ascii_motifs.rule: Preserve exactly ONE instance of each procedural motif across the entire page.

motifs.name: MacBook Sync Execution Terminal
motifs.type: Procedural code execution typewriter in MacBook screen

motifs.name: Ocean Wave Canvas
motifs.type: Procedural monochrome wave canvas in footer close

rules: NO spring bounce or elastic overshoot.
Animations MUST only use GPU-accelerated CSS properties: `transform` and `opacity`.
Transitions MUST be element-specific (e.g. `transition: transform 0.2s ease-out, opacity 0.2s ease-out`), NEVER `transition: all`.
Full support for `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` via `useAcoordReducedMotion` hook.

agent_engine_optimization_aeo.json_ld_schema: Structured JSON-LD inserted in <head> representing SoftwareApplication & Organization schemas for agentic crawler discovery.
agent_engine_optimization_aeo.machine_readable_summaries: Every major section includes an accessible machine-readable summary paragraph formatted in JetBrains Mono with explicit metadata attributes.
agent_engine_optimization_aeo.discoverability: llms.txt and sitemap.xml links provided in footer for LLM web crawlers.
agent_engine_optimization_aeo.disclaimers: Visible modeled-claim disclaimer notice present under ROI and Performance metrics ('*Modeled operational estimates based on synthetic benchmark data').

accessibility.contrast: WCAG AAA compliant monochrome (black bg #000000 with white text #ffffff provides 21:1 ratio).
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case (e.g., `data-testid='waitlist-submit-button'`, `data-testid='tab-workflows'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Consolidate the homepage into the strict 5-part structure: Hands -> AHI Eye Intro -> 30/70 Compact MacBook Demo -> Tabbed Proof -> Founder/Ocean Close.
Ensure direct routes /pricing, /partners, /roi, /use-cases/healthcare, and /use-cases/cfo are accessible in navigation and footer.
Scale down MacBook demo width on desktop to create a zoomed-out compact feel (~85% scale).
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive controls and key section containers.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in sticky headers or overlays.
